cautions.quote: If the Prefer header is not added, the following error will occur: The data does not represent a valid JSON token.
If you forget to do this, the following error will be displayed: 400 {"error":{"code":"0x80060888","message":"Bad Request – Error in query syntax."}}
Because there is no way to return a value after deleting data, do not try to read the response text after deleting it.
This requires setting the DelayedInsert property of the page to true
